targets.outcome_quote: Although we replicated the majority of the psychosocial gains across the three SA cohorts, one of the most notable differences that emerged from the 2016 and 2017 cohorts, compared with the 2015 cohort, was that pre-med students increased in their intention to leave their STEM major from pre- to posttest.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly describe replicated psychosocial gains together with an opposing intention-to-leave result in both new cohorts. Statements supporting key gains do not override this explicitly contrasted finding with an overall replication verdict.
